description: Fetch new sentences from an in-progress or just-ended meeting transcript. Identify the meeting via meetingAssistantEventId (preferred) or mediaId. Pass back the previous response's nextCursor as sinceEndInSec to receive only what's been added since.

mediaId.description: Media id of the live meeting. Either this or meetingAssistantEventId is required.

meetingAssistantEventId.description: Meeting assistant event id from list_meeting_events. Either this or mediaId is required.

sinceEndInSec.description: Pass the nextCursor value from your previous response to skip already-seen sentences. Omit on the first call.

name: get_live_meeting_transcript

data.description: Response payload from the Speak AI API

title: Get Live Meeting Transcript
